newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market not tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market not tested-USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
There were 30,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 18,400 head formulated cattle to be shipped this week. The last established price was 67.00 on Friday.
Tuesday's packer bids were 66.00-67.00 with asking prices 68.00-69.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - 200 Year Ago - 700
Wk to date - 30,200 Week Ago - 22,000 Year Ago - 14,200
